q1_issues.issue: The noun-modifying "between Cincinnati Reds and Boston Red Sox" PP is promoted to two `Agent` atoms on the playing event (statements 3 and 4), but the clause is an agentless passive whose agent atom the instruction set says to omit, so the teams' doing of the playing is added rather than stated.
"a series was played" gives an object whose change under the action is at best unclear, and the instruction set's stated default for the unclear case is `Theme`, not `Patient`.

q2_gaps: "another N": an additive determiner presupposing a prior instance of the kind — the instruction set covers event-level "again" (`Again`) and "also" (`Also`) but gives no encoding for NP-level "another", so the presupposition is silently dropped
"between X and Y": a two-object preposition — the preposition-named oblique form takes a single object, and no rule maps a between-participants phrase onto a thematic role or onto the modified noun
notes: "In Havana" is correctly an event `Location` and every proper noun carries its `Name` atom. The whole faithfulness risk in this item sits in how the between-phrase was routed.
